subject: planner: apply predicate simplification before extract condition (#62211)
summary: Diff touches `pkg/planner/core/operator/logicalop/logical_join.go` (inner/semi join `LogicalJoin.PredicatePushDown`). It replaces the pre-extract `expression.PropagateConstant(...)` pass on the combined join+filter condition set with `utilfuncp.ApplyPredicateSimplification(..., propagateConstant=true)` and removes the post-extract simplification of `otherCond` before assigning `p.OtherConditions`. Net effect: predicate simplification (including short-circuiting after constant-propagation within DNFs) happens before `ExtractOnCondition`, enabling more exact left/right predicate extraction/pushdown and avoiding leaving simplified side-only filters in `OtherConditions`. Integration tests add a case covering the intended join predicate simplification behavior. No remaining Blocker/High correctness or SQL-semantics issues identified in this change.
